claim_boundary: The amplification theorem requires conditionally independent, identically distributed replication errors with one rate p<=eta, truth-independent error bits, registered meaning-preserving copies, and terminal observation of every response. Marginal accuracy alone does not imply this profile.

correlation_class_separation_witness.persistent_law: one latent Bernoulli(eta) flip copied to every replication

theorem.bayes_error: upper binomial tail plus half the even-depth tie mass
theorem.noise_class: iid Bernoulli error rate p chosen adversarially in [0,eta]
